interface.signature: maxCandies(status, candies, keys, containedBoxes, initialBoxes) -> int

preconditions.description: The lengths of status, candies, keys, and containedBoxes are all equal.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= i < len(status) for i in initialBoxes)
preconditions.description: All initialBoxes indices are within the range of status.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= i < len(status) for j in keys[i] for i in range(len(keys)))
preconditions.description: All keys are within the range of status.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= i < len(status) for j in containedBoxes[i] for i in range(len(containedBoxes)))
preconditions.description: All containedBoxes are within the range of status.

preconditions.expression: all(status[i] == 0 or status[i] == 1 for i in range(len(status)))
preconditions.description: All status values are either 0 or 1.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= candies[i] <= 1000 for i in range(len(candies)))
preconditions.description: All candies values are between 0 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(len(keys[i]) <= len(status) for i in range(len(keys)))
preconditions.description: The number of keys in each box does not exceed the number of boxes.

preconditions.expression: all(len(containedBoxes[i]) <= len(status) for i in range(len(containedBoxes)))
preconditions.description: The number of contained boxes in each box does not exceed the number of boxes.

preconditions.expression: all(keys[i][j] != i for i in range(len(keys)) for j in range(len(keys[i])))
preconditions.description: Keys do not point to the box they are in.

preconditions.expression: all(containedBoxes[i][j] != i for i in range(len(containedBoxes)) for j in range(len(containedBoxes[i])))
preconditions.description: Contained boxes do not include the box they are in.

preconditions.expression: all(status[i] == 1 or keys[i] for i in range(len(status)))
preconditions.description: All boxes are either open or contain keys.

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(candies[i] for i in range(len(status)) if status[i] == 1 or i in open_boxes)
postconditions.description: The total number of candies collected is the sum of candies in open boxes and boxes with initial access.

invariants.expression: open_boxes == {i for i in range(len(status)) if status[i] == 1}
invariants.description: The set of open boxes is the set of boxes with status 1.

invariants.expression: available_keys == set().union(*(keys[i] for i in open_boxes))
invariants.description: The set of available keys is the union of keys from all open boxes.

invariants.expression: available_boxes == set().union(*(containedBoxes[i] for i in open_boxes))
invariants.description: The set of available boxes is the union of contained boxes from all open boxes.
The set of open boxes is a subset of the range of status.
The set of available keys is a subset of the range of status.
The set of available boxes is a subset of the range of status.
